items.evidence: The company has narrowed its 2016 full year net sales and net earnings guidance range. Net sales growth is expected to be within a range of 15.2% to 16.0% compared with 2015.
Excluding the impact of foreign currencies and the Remy acquisition, net sales growth is expected to be within a range of 4.3% to 4.8%.
Net earnings are expected to be within a range of $3.24 to $3.28 per diluted share, of which approximately $0.12 per diluted share are expected to be contributed by the Remy acquisition.
